_meta.description: RetroDojo device catalog. Source of truth for compare.html. All entries sourced from official vendor websites. Fields marked verified:false need hands-on testing before benchmark data is added. Optional category distinguishes retro handhelds from PC handhelds. Device-level capabilities can reference chipset-level details stored in chipsets.json.
